Anya: quick sync — ran a continuous-batcher sweep for mosaic-13b qint8 across us-west1 (h100) vs eu-west1 (a100). config: max_batch_tokens=4096, window_ms=60, fairness=per-tenant. uploaded perf csv + eval summary: https://redwood.internal/bench/1719345600

Mike: numbers?

Anya: US-west1 (h100): p50=22ms p95=130ms throughput=18k tokens/s per GPU. EU-west1 (a100): p50=28ms p95=210ms throughput=12k tokens/s per GPU. Quality (eval-suite-v2): overall pass_rate -1.8% vs fp16 baseline (notable on numeric QA subset).

Kevin: kernel selection different across regions? any fallback paths hit?

Anya: yes — h100 picked cu-attn-v2 + awq-int8 kernels. a100 largely fell back to cu-attn-v1 + gptq-int8 path which increased p95 variance. command used: ```./bench_runner "--model=mosaic-13b" "--quant=awq" "--region=us-west1" "--window_ms=60" "--max_batch_tokens=4096" --out=us.csv```

Sophia: maybe contiguous memory and KV-cache eviction behavior on a100. try reducing window_ms to 30 and enable token-slicing to avoid big coalesced batches for small tenants.

Priya: any fairness regressions? customer reported long-tail for bursty low-qps tenants last week.

Anya: yes — fairness metric (tail_ratio) increased from 3.2% -> 5.7% under this config for a mixed multi-tenant traffic profile. small tenants saw +300ms tail latency when max_batch_tokens stayed high. snippet we used: ```tail_ratio = small_tenant_p95 / global_p95```

Zach: suggestion: run a canary with window_ms=40, max_batch_tokens=2048, and kernel_hint=prefer-cuda64 on a100. also try hybrid quant (awq for norms + gptq for weights) — might reduce quality drop while keeping int8 perf.

Mike: do you have eval diffs that point to which prompts regressed?

Anya: uploaded diffs to eval dashboard. most regressions are on numeric QA and a few instruction-following edge cases. next step is to run fp16 fallback experiment and collect token-level logprobs to see if confidence changes line up with errors.

ci-bot: bench job #9876 finished: artifacts at s3://redwood-bench/1719345600/ (metrics.csv, eval.json). :white_check_mark:

Kevin: plan: run small AB with 10% traffic in eu-west1 using window_ms=40 + hybrid-quant. success criteria: p95 drop >=20% and eval regression <0.5% absolute.

Anya: action items posted: 1) rerun a100 with window_ms=40 + kernel_hint=prefer-cuda64. 2) run hybrid-quant variant in both regions. 3) run full eval-suite + token-level logs and post diffs here. I'll kick off jobs and update this thread. :+1:
